prior_summary: Single full-task DDPM with Cartesian TCP positions expressed in a smooth causal blend of the observed block frame and an observed target-derived drawer-handle anchor; this makes block approach/carry motion and drawer interaction translation-relative without runtime stages.
applicable_conditions: Use for constrained_retrieve_store when object_pose, target_pose, drawer state, robot state, and TCP pose have the declared semantics; the displaced block and all requested TCP poses must remain reachable through the fixed tunnel and drawer geometry.
termination_guidance: The unchanged task completion condition is that the retrieved block is inside the drawer and the drawer is closed below 0.025 m; the demonstrated policy then opens the gripper and retreats. This text is documentation, not a runtime controller or extra success rule.
limitations: Training contains one strategy and only about 12 mm initial x/y block-position spread. The prior handles translations while its active reference remains semantically correct, but not arbitrary object rotation, topology changes, unreachable positions, severe contact perturbations, or a changed target-to-handle offset. No contact truth is observed.
